div.head: Wer 6
div.ab: Of ðam dæge, ðe ðæt healsfang agolden sy, on XXI nihtan gylde man ða manbote; ðæs on XXI nihtan ðæt fyhtewite; ðæs on XXI nihtan ðæs weres ðæt frumgyld; 7 swa forð, ðæt fulgolden sy on ðam fyrste, ðe witan geræden.

From the day when healsfang is to be paid, within twenty-one days, manbot is to be paid; then within twenty-one days the fighting-fine; then within twenty-one days the first instalment of the wergeld; and so on, until full payment is made within the time-limit that the witan have ordained.

Of ðam dæge, þe þæt healsfang agolden sy, on XXI nihtan gylde man ða manbote; ðæs on XXI nihtan þæt fyht[e]wite; ðæs on XXI nihtan ðæs weres þæt frumgyld; 7 swa forð, þæt fulgolden sy on ðam fyrste, ðe witan geræddan.
